create_CocoEvaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with ground truth COCO data and specified IoU types for object detection evaluation
update_CocoEvaluator_predictions: update the CocoEvaluator with new model predictions to accumulate per-image evaluation results across batches
prepare_coco_detection_results: prepare model predictions into COCO detection format with bounding boxes, scores, and category labels
prepare_coco_segmentation_results: prepare model predictions into COCO segmentation format with RLE-encoded masks, scores, and category labels
convert_boxes_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format for COCO evaluation compatibility
